correctness.rationale: Irreducibility: one can remove each B particle and transfer residual A particles to B for removal; from empty, form the desired B subset by successive A injections and transfers, then inject the desired A subset. Uniqueness implies within-class exchangeability. The single-site balances are n d=alpha(1-x), m d=beta y, and net edge flux is x-y since the blocking terms cancel. For the cross pair, write U=eta_i-x and V=eta_j-y. Their shared swap changes the product to (V-d)(U+d), with mean change -d^2. Other edges replace one centered factor, yielding (m-1)(u-w)+(n-1)(v-w); the bath terms contribute -(alpha+beta)w. Within a class both sites give the same drift n(w-u)-alpha u, or m(w-v)-beta v. Solving gives all three covariances and their strict signs. At fixed ratio, write D=tG and d=t/(t+C). The derivative of |w| has numerator H=(C-t)G-t(t+C)G' and positive denominator (t+C)^3 G^2. Each reciprocal contribution to H has derivative -[(2C-p)t+p^2]/(t+p)^3, or the analogous q term; hence H strictly decreases from positive at C to negative at infinity. The unique root is the maximum and exceeds C. The balanced expression gives N|w(N tau)|=tau(tau+1/2)/[2(tau+1)^2(tau+1-1/N)]. It and its tau derivative converge on compact positive intervals; the limiting derivative has numerator 1+2 tau-2 tau^2. Bracketing the unique finite-size root on either side of the positive limiting root gives both constants. For gamma<1, d~N^(gamma-1)/L and D~K N^gamma; at gamma=1 all four terms of D are order N, and above it d tends to 1 and D~(a+b)N^gamma. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The equal-rate covariance evaluation is an exercise in symmetry reduction of the known operator representation, and the method and strict negative-correlation background are not claimed as advances. More importantly, proving the derivative has exactly one positive root for every rate ratio and controlling that root in the balanced growth limit requires a separate argument not given by these representations or algorithms.

value.rationale: An all-rates exact stationary covariance in a basic solvable open-network geometry gives a rigorous rate selection law. The unique interior peak, explicit crossover and balanced constants quantify how the nonequilibrium covariance responds when both reservoirs speed up, in contrast with the strictly increasing net flux at fixed rate ratio. This goes beyond a sign test or a single numerical optimum.
